From: Mark Robert Miller <markrmiller@apache.org>

Subject: [PATCH] SOLR-2331,SOLR-2691: Refactor CoreContainer's SolrXML
 serialization code and improve testing

git-svn-id: https://svn.apache.org/repos/asf/lucene/dev/trunk@1153564 13f79535-47bb-0310-9956-ffa450edef68

diff --git a/solr/CHANGES.txt b/solr/CHANGES.txt
index b13965d24a9..b12c0eb423a 100644
--- a/solr/CHANGES.txt
+++ b/solr/CHANGES.txt
@@ -281,6 +281,9 @@ Other Changes
 * SOLR-2663: FieldTypePluginLoader has been refactored out of IndexSchema 
   and made public. (hossman)
 
+* SOLR-2331,SOLR-2691: Refactor CoreContainer's SolrXML serialization code and improve testing
+  (Yury Kats, hossman, Mark Miller)
+
 Documentation
 ----------------------
 

diff --git a/solr/core/src/java/org/apache/solr/core/CoreContainer.java b/solr/core/src/java/org/apache/solr/core/CoreContainer.java
index fd63fbfa72f..c383b0b8801 100644
--- a/solr/core/src/java/org/apache/solr/core/CoreContainer.java
+++ b/solr/core/src/java/org/apache/solr/core/CoreContainer.java
@@ -903,8 +903,8 @@ public class CoreContainer
     List<SolrCoreXMLDef> solrCoreXMLDefs = new ArrayList<SolrCoreXMLDef>();
     
     synchronized (cores) {
-      Map<String,String> coreAttribs = new HashMap<String,String>();
       for (SolrCore solrCore : cores.values()) {
+        Map<String,String> coreAttribs = new HashMap<String,String>();
         CoreDescriptor dcore = solrCore.getCoreDescriptor();
         
         coreAttribs.put("name", dcore.name.equals("") ? defaultCoreName

### Modifications Summary

**1. Changes in `CHANGES.txt`:**
- Added an entry documenting the refactoring of CoreContainer's SolrXML serialization code and improvements in testing. This entry is associated with issues SOLR-2331 and SOLR-2691, and credits contributors Yury Kats, hossman, and Mark Miller.

**2. Changes in `CoreContainer.java`:**
- The initialization of the `coreAttribs` HashMap was moved inside the loop that iterates through the `cores` collection. This change ensures that a new `coreAttribs` map is created for each `SolrCore` instance, rather than sharing the same map across all instances.

### Relationships:
The modifications in `CHANGES.txt` provide a summary of the refactoring efforts completed in `CoreContainer.java`, linking the documentation of the changes to the specific code adjustments made to improve the functionality and testing of Solr's XML serialization code. This relationship highlights that the changes in the codebase are significant enough to be noted in the project's change log, indicating an improvement in the overall structure and maintainability of the code.

This could lead to incorrect serialization and unpredictable behavior because the attributes assigned to one core could inadvertently affect another.

```java
Map<String,String> coreAttribs = new HashMap<String,String>();
```
```java
synchronized (cores) {
```
Reason:
The fix involves moving the declaration of `coreAttribs` inside the loop that processes each `SolrCore`, ensuring that each core has its own separate instance of `coreAttribs`. By doing this, concurrent processing will not lead to conflicts between attribute values. Additionally, the `synchronized (cores)` block ensures that the iteration over `cores` is thread-safe, preventing multiple threads from modifying the same data structure simultaneously.
